_notes.targetFps: Optional per-camera key. Add lane_config.cameras[].targetFps to set per-stream target FPS. If omitted, stream density falls back to global TARGET_FPS.

_about.name: Self-checkout lane with a vision-language model
_about.summary: YOLO11n detects items in the lane, and a local vision-language model (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct) identifies the specific product beyond the detector's generic class
_about.why_run_it: Shows what adding a local vision-language model to a lane costs, in stream density and in time to first token and token throughput
